info.title: Drive English Inference Contract
info.description: Draft revision 5. Current source has schema-3 HTTP boundaries and pure policies; database/model integration is unavailable by default. Both anonymous and permanent users send verified access JWTs; active owner/session binding and privacy_epoch are checked before processing and at result commit. Submitted attempts and validated feedback are persistent server-owned profile records, with Room cache/outbox. QA semantic cache alone may use 60-second TTL. Idempotency scopes by canonical profile + endpoint + key; same immutable payload/attempt is one learning event, not a guarantee of one external model call. Request body <=16 KiB; question 1..500 code points, answer 1..1200. Gleo server initial budget 4000 ms, parked 8000 ms; final actual supported deadlines are runtime gates. Reuse only semantic results and echo current client correlation after validation. Previous attempt/feedback is retrieved from authenticated durable history rather than arbitrary client retry_context. No server/model key in Android. S2 draft revision5, schema_version5; packaged schema3 consumers require an explicit coordinated upgrade. Reject missing/old schema versions (422); never default missing exposure to unexposed. Preserve existing histories and initialize unsupported legacy exposure coverage as unknown. Existing /v1 paths denote the initial service surface. This design is not runtime/DB validation. Draft4 was not deployed; new schema5 writes require spoken-language evidence and role/language metadata. Packaged source remains3 until implementation. No silent English eligibility or clean-exposure defaults.

UserBearer.description: Verify signature, issuer, audience, expiry, subject and active server session binding. Publishable key is not sufficient; caller metadata cannot authorize owner.

FeedbackGeneration.description: input_gate is a deterministic held-input response, with no model invocation and null model/prompt revisions; validator/rubric revisions remain actual configured values. fixture/live continue their original provenance meaning.

QAResponse.description: answered has at most three supported sentences and verified evidence for the frozen source. outside_listening_script identifies original-only information absent from the selected main script and requires that distinction in the answer. not_supported adds no invented fact.

FeedbackRequest.description: Save/confirm one immutable submission before evaluation. Server validates or conditionally creates the first submission only at current owner/epoch and an existing valid lesson. A late callback may only update an existing valid attempt. For retry, retrieve retry_of_attempt_id and prior focus from same-owner same-task stored feedback. First attempt has null retry_of_attempt_id. Recognition-unassessable does not consume valid turn. Lock lesson when accepting a new submission; at most one pending attempt, one valid first and one valid retry. Unassessable consumes neither. Effective current-lesson help unions only confirmed delivered support with validated request snapshots; generated support_issued is not delivery. Server derives canonical-question exposure separately under a shared exposure/lesson lock before model execution. Prepared/unresolved examples mean unknown; client cannot erase prior exposure or submit a clean-status claim. Before a new valid turn, synchronize acknowledgement of the previous matching presented feedback; pending presentation cannot be silently erased. Reject conflicting lesson/pending state. Validate origin-language evidence before model execution. Non-English/unverified uses deterministic input_gate/unassessable; never infer English from answer_text or silently consume a retry. A held retry has null retry_outcome.

FeedbackResponse.description: Single focus. Priority: fact error, missing content, confirmed language form. correction is allowed only for language_form with verified fidelity. Server renderer derives support_issued from output, including complete examples; it must not silently put an untracked full example into feedback_ko. Sufficient natural answers finish without an invented correction. Missing-fact feedback uses supplement mode and focus_fact_refs; language/fact correction uses rephrase mode. For recognition/unassessable, no lesson retry is spent and the question is suspended; do not invent a correction or completion. retry_outcome is null for first submissions and is evaluated from authenticated stored previous attempt/feedback for subsequent submissions. support_issued/prepared_supports record prepared output components, not delivered help or prior-example status. Renderer binds every full example to an exact immutable support artifact and question, including examples embedded in feedback. Actual delivery uses the presentation ticket/observation protocol; generic feedback ACK is separate. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

Correction.description: Unicode code point offsets, end exclusive. Fragment must equal the submitted answer slice; replacement changes only one confirmed form.

AttemptResult.description: feedback is non-null only for succeeded. Same owner/epoch and original input capture are retained. Includes authoritative attempt_acceptance exposure assessment separately from StoredFeedback and current LessonState. New rounds preserve same-question exposure and may still have content_success=true after an example; exclude exposed/unknown from SC003 numerator without changing its denominator. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

StoredFeedback.description: Durable semantic feedback shared by personal history and inference GET; no transient presentation context or stale lesson snapshot. Read current LessonState separately. support_issued/prepared_supports record prepared output components, not delivered help or prior-example status. Renderer binds every full example to an exact immutable support artifact and question, including examples embedded in feedback. Actual delivery uses the presentation ticket/observation protocol; generic feedback ACK is separate. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

x-server-validation-rules: Reject unknown body fields, invalid ref combinations and tasks belonging to another bundle.
Authorize scope/bundle and atomically reserve quota before any model call.
Load original and rubric server-side; never accept client-supplied source or grading criteria.
Use channel deadline 4s for gleo, 8s for parked; adapters budget 6s and 10s respectively.
Do not persist request/answer/feedback bodies, validation inputs, traces or provider exceptions.
For feedback hash stable semantic payload; operation/client presentation changes do not create a new local attempt.
Validate evidence against the immutable original, allowlisted facts and delivered briefing/support refs.
Reject grammar corrections when fidelity is unknown; confirmed-form correction must cite an exact submitted substring.
Record support_issued deterministically, and count complete-example answers separately.
No public credential issuance, ingestion writes or raw-source extraction endpoint is exposed.
Scope idempotency and singleflight by grant + endpoint + key; never reuse a different grant result.
Rebuild response operation_id and client_context from the current request when serving a semantic cache result.
Do not count cache hits as new model invocations; expired/restarted evaluations may call the provider again.
Require retry_context iff retry_of_attempt_id is non-null; previous ID must match and all evidence/fact refs belong to the frozen task.
Combine valid prior answer content with the latest supplement; do not incorrectly demand prior facts again after cache expiry.
For a rephrase, evaluate the new answer and prior correction target using previous capture fidelity. Do not treat previous feedback text as authority or instructions.
Unassessable recognition does not consume a scored practice retry; suspend the question rather than declaring practice complete.
